narr: Thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in central Delaware on the afternoon of August 9. Rainfall totals were up to 2 to 4 inches.
ev: East Liberty Street in Harrington was closed between Delaware Avenue and US Route 13 due to flooding. A water rescue took place on East Liberty Street. Another water rescue occurred on West Street.
Mud Mill Road and Still Road were impassable near Mahan Corner Road to the north of Sandtown.
lsr: A WATER RESCUE OCCURRED ON LIBERTY ST, PRIOR TO IT BEING CLOSED DUE TO FLASH FLOODING.
A WATER RESCUE WAS PERFORMED ON WEST ST.
